headline: SUPER JUNIOR-D&E announce 2027 tour 'D&ESTIVAL'
sub: 'THE 15/15' marks 15 years of Donghae & Eunhyuk's unit

points.title: What to know
items: Also Macau, Kobe, Kaohsiung, Hong Kong
More stops are teased to be added
Donghae shared the poster on Instagram

source: Source: SUPER JUNIOR-D&E official channels, via Korean media
caption:
SUPER JUNIOR-D&E are going on tour in 2027!

Donghae and Eunhyuk unveiled the poster for their live tour 'D&ESTIVAL: THE 15/15', named for the unit's 15th anniversary. The tour opens Jan 9-10 at NAVER ARENA at INSPIRE in Incheon, then heads to Taipei, Yokohama, Bangkok, Macau, Kobe, Kaohsiung and Hong Kong, with more stops teased.
